name: check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3

name: gitea-few8w
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; GDP_FEW=8 GDP_ENGINE_WALL=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/realworld/score.ts --one 'approval/gitea/reviews' 0 --ms 60000 2>/tmp/e.log | tail -1 | cut -c1-250; echo engine_events $(grep -cE 'join (template|small instance|enumerated)' /tmp/e.log); grep -E 'join (small instance|enumerated|set|houdini|failed)' /tmp/e.log | tail -6 | cut -c1-200

name: lock_server_sync-s60-r1-few8w
cmd: GDP_FEW=8 GDP_ENGINE_WALL=1 GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only lock_server_sync --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set|frames|failed|houdini)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 40000; exit $s
